text.ms:
1. (1) Kaedah-kaedah ini bolehlah dinamakan Kaedah-Kaedah (Perancangan)

Wilayah Persekutuan (Fi bagi Pembelian Pelan Tempatan (Perubahan 4)) 2023.

(2) Kaedah-Kaedah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 23 Oktober 2023.

Fi

2. Fi bagi pembelian salinan Pelan Bandar Raya Kuala Lumpur 2020 (Perubahan 4)

hendaklah sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

 ANWAR BIN IBRAHIM

 Perdana Menteri

FEDERAL TERRITORY (PLANNING) ACT 1982

FEDERAL TERRITORY (PLANNING) (FEE FOR PURCHASE OF LOCAL PLAN

(ALTERATION 4)) RULES 2023

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 64(2)(j)

of the Federal Territory (Planning) Act 1982 [Act 267], the Commissioner,

with the approval of the Minister, makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Federal Territory (Planning)

(Fee for Purchase of Local Plan (Alteration 4)) Rules 2023.

(2) These Rules come into operation on 23 October 2023.

Fee

2. The fee for the purchase of a copy of the Kuala Lumpur City Plan 2020

(Alteration 4) shall be as specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

[Rule 2]

Copy Fee per copy

(RM)

Hard copy 200.00

Electronic form 50.00

Made 20 September 2023

[DBKL/JUP/BPPP/GN/808 JLD. 11; PN(PU2)396/Jld.9]

 DATUK SR. HAJI KAMARULZAMAN BIN MAT SALLEH

 Commissioner of the City of Kuala Lumpur

Approved 9 October 2023

[DBKL/JUP/BPPP/GN 808 JLD 12; PN(PU2)396/Jld.9]

 ANWAR BIN IBRAHIM

 Prime Minister
